frontier.mechanism: combine.c's try_combine runs after flow.c has fixed reg_n_refs, so a reference in an insn combine absorbs is both counted and byte-free (the shape E-s16-5 proved target's own stptr reference has); E-s23-1 proves a USE is safe where a DEFINITION is not, because a use records no expression in cse's table. E-s24-5 removes the tbl half of the problem from the critical path.
